t: The $(item)Vortex Cannon/$ is a weapon which shoots $(thing)vortices/$: air spinning in a way that it doesn't have much friction and can be mostly stable.$(p)You can use this to shoot gusts at the target of choice: to repel enemies, push animals around, uproot plants and leaves, or shear entities.
$(item)涡流炮/$是一种会发射$(thing)涡旋/$的武器：高速旋转的空气因摩擦极小而大多能够保持稳定。$(p)你可以用它向选定的目标发射阵风：击退敌人、推动动物、连根拔起植物和树叶，或是给实体剪毛。

The higher the $(item)Vortex Cannon/$ is pressurized, the more impact it has on its targets and the greater its range is.$(p)Note that it's possible to catch yourself in a fired vortex, which can be very useful for fast transport. But beware: it provides no fall damage protection!
$(item)涡流炮/$的压力越高，对目标的冲击力就越强，射程也就越远。$(p)注意，你也有可能被自己发射出的涡流卷入，这对于快速移动非常有用。但要小心：它不会提供任何摔落伤害保护！
